english.title: Cause the driving of a vehicle in contravention of prohibition after failure to pay financial penalty deposit
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be driven on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), in contravention of a notice in writing prohibiting the driving of that vehicle under section 90D(2) of the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988
english.legislation: Contrary to section 90D(6)(b) of and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:

english.notes: This offence was inserted into the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988 by section 11 of the Road Safety Act 2006.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant caused **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..) to drive a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), in contravention of a notice in writing prohibiting the driving of that vehicle under section 90D(2) of the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
